card.name: Zuzu
traits: bright pink bow between its ears
holds an orange carrot with green leafy top
happy curved black eyes and whiskers
round puffy white tail with a purple outline
card.one_line: Zuzu is a cheerful little bunny with a bright pink bow who loves to hop around carrying a fresh crunchy carrot.

pages.scenario: Zuzu with her bright pink bow finds a basket of sweet carrots. She hops happily in the meadow.
pages.question: What should sweet Zuzu do with her full basket?

choices.text: Hide all the carrots in a secret hole.
choices.feedback: Zuzu knows it is much more fun to share with friends.

choices.text: Share the carrots with her meadow friends.
choices.feedback: Sharing treats makes Zuzu and all her friends smile brightly.

pages.image_prompt: Zuzu the cheerful white bunny wearing a bright pink bow between her ears, sitting next to a wooden basket filled with fresh orange carrots in a sunny flower meadow, soft children's-book watercolour style, no text in the image
pages.narration_text: Zuzu with her bright pink bow finds a basket of sweet carrots. She hops happily in the meadow. What should sweet Zuzu do with her full basket?

pages.scenario: Little bunny Zuzu with her bright pink bow sees Pip the mouse.
pages.question: What should kind Zuzu do for her hungry friend?

choices.text: Munch on the carrot all by herself.
choices.feedback: Zuzu knows that sharing food with a friend brings more happiness.

choices.text: Snap a carrot in half and share it with Pip.
choices.feedback: Sharing lunch makes Pip smile and fills Zuzu with sweet joy.

pages.image_prompt: Bunny Zuzu wearing a bright pink bow between her ears sits on a picnic blanket on Clover Hill, softly smiling at a tiny mouse, soft children's-book watercolour style, no text in the image
pages.narration_text: Little bunny Zuzu with her bright pink bow sees Pip the mouse. What should kind Zuzu do for her hungry friend?

pages.scenario: Zuzu with her bright pink bow meets Toby the tired turtle. Toby sits on a warm rock and feels very hungry.
pages.question: What should sweet Zuzu choose to do?

choices.text: Share some crunchy carrot slices with Toby.
choices.feedback: Sharing treats makes Toby smile and makes Zuzu feel so happy!

choices.text: Hop away quickly across the brook.
choices.feedback: Zuzu can stop to help her hungry turtle friend first.

pages.image_prompt: Zuzu the white bunny with a bright pink bow between her ears sharing orange carrot slices with a friendly little turtle on a smooth river stone by a babbling brook, soft children's book watercolor style, no text
pages.narration_text: Zuzu with her bright pink bow meets Toby the tired turtle. Toby sits on a warm rock and feels very hungry. What should sweet Zuzu choose to do?

pages.scenario: Little Zuzu with her bright pink bow meets Barnaby the bear.
pages.question: How can Zuzu make Barnaby happy at the swing?

choices.text: Share her leafy greens with Barnaby.
choices.feedback: Zuzu and Barnaby smile as they make fun crowns together!

choices.text: Keep all the leafy greens for herself.
choices.feedback: Sharing will make both Zuzu and Barnaby feel much happier.

pages.image_prompt: Bunny Zuzu wearing a bright pink bow between her ears sits by an oak tree swing sharing leafy green carrot tops with a friendly little bear cub, soft children's book watercolour style, no text in the image
pages.narration_text: Little Zuzu with her bright pink bow meets Barnaby the bear. How can Zuzu make Barnaby happy at the swing?

pages.scenario: A cold wind blows on Zuzu with her bright pink bow. Her forest friends feel very chilly.
pages.question: What should Zuzu do with her warm pink scarf?

choices.text: Wrap the scarf only around herself
choices.feedback: Zuzu wants her friends to feel warm and happy too.

choices.text: Spread the scarf over all her friends together
choices.feedback: Sharing the scarf keeps everyone warm and brings big happy smiles!

pages.image_prompt: Little white bunny Zuzu with a bright pink bow between her ears sharing a soft pink scarf with her animal friends in a leafy woods clearing, gentle watercolor illustration for children, soft colors, storybook art, no text
pages.narration_text: A cold wind blows on Zuzu with her bright pink bow. Her forest friends feel very chilly. What should Zuzu do with her warm pink scarf?

pages.scenario: Inside the cozy cave, Zuzu with her bright pink bow has one giant carrot.
pages.question: What should Zuzu do with her big sweet carrot?

choices.text: Slice it into pieces to share with all her friends.
choices.feedback: Sharing the sweet carrot makes Zuzu and her friends smile happily.

choices.text: Gobble the carrot all by herself very quickly.
choices.feedback: Eating alone is okay, but sharing brings even more joy.

pages.image_prompt: Zuzu the cheerful white bunny wearing a bright pink bow between her ears sits in a soft cozy cave holding a giant carrot, surrounded by friendly animal pals, soft children's-book watercolour style, no text in the image
pages.narration_text: Inside the cozy cave, Zuzu with her bright pink bow has one giant carrot. What should Zuzu do with her big sweet carrot?

pages.scenario: The sun shines on Zuzu and her bright pink bow. Her forest friends bring sweet berries and nuts for Zuzu.
pages.question: What should happy Zuzu do with all the yummy treats?

choices.text: Share everything together in one big, happy feast.
choices.feedback: Sharing the feast makes Zuzu and all her friends smile.

choices.text: Keep all the sweet treats just for herself.
choices.feedback: Zuzu knows it is much more fun to share together.

pages.image_prompt: Watercolor illustration of Zuzu the bunny wearing a bright pink bow between her ears, sitting in a sunny clearing surrounded by friendly woodland animals with berries and nuts, soft pastel colors, children's book style, no text
pages.narration_text: The sun shines on Zuzu and her bright pink bow. Her forest friends bring sweet berries and nuts for Zuzu. What should happy Zuzu do with all the yummy treats?

pages.scenario: The sun sets over the hill. Zuzu wiggles her round puffy white tail with joy.
pages.question: What should cheerful Zuzu do now?

choices.text: Walk away alone to count her leftover snacks.
choices.feedback: Playing together after sharing is much more fun for Zuzu.

choices.text: Hold hands and play with her happy friends.
choices.feedback: Sharing made Zuzu and all her friends so happy!

promises.title: Zuzu Shares Her Cherished Carrot
promises.plain: Zuzu actively shares her signature crunchy orange carrot with a friend, showing that sharing brings joy to both.

promises.title: Joyful Reaction After Sharing
promises.plain: In the scene where sharing occurs, both Zuzu and the receiver must visibly show happiness.
